runs.name: Ballard Power Systems Inc.; Nasdaq and TSX BLDP, SEC CIK 0001453015, British Columbia, 40-F filer reporting in US dollars; design, manufacture, sale and service of PEM fuel cell products for bus, truck, rail, marine, stationary and emerging applications, a 49% interest in the Weichai-Ballard JV (fully impaired Q4 2025); restructurings 2023 to 2025, CEO Randy MacEwen succeeded by Marty Neese 2025-07-07; GeoPura bought 2026-08-28 for GBP 82.5M cash and 49,584,212 shares plus 1,084,540 owed under RSUs; the AIF names thirteen rivals, Plug Power and Cummins (Accelera) the SEC filers compared
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; INTEGRITY FACTS RECORDED, NOT JUDGED
runs.entry: Price **$1.57** (close 2026-10-16, Nasdaq, aggregator, flagged). Shares 300,784,816 on the cover of the 40-F for FY2025 (`Screens/cover_shares.py` agreeing, equal to the filed statement of changes in equity, no treasury shares), 301,506,494 at 2026-06-30 (Q2 interim, 6-K 0001628280-26-051245), plus 49,584,212 GeoPura shares and 1,084,540 owed under RSUs (6-K 0001279569-26-000834): **352,175,246** used, the RSUs counted as deal consideration and options left out, a CONVENTION of the run. Sovereign **5.43%**, US Treasury 30-year par yield of 2026-10-16 (issuing authority). Read from the 40-F for FY2025 (0001628280-26-017045: AIF, MD&A, audited statements, KPMG report of 2026-03-11), the 40-Fs for FY2023 (0001453015-24-000002) and FY2021 (0001453015-22-000003), the Q2 2026 interim statements, the 2026 circular (6-K 0001206774-26-000242) and every 2026 news-release 6-K; FY2025 operating cash $(56,167) thousand checked to the filed statement; 2016 to 2020 from the issuer's tagged IFRS facts. `tools/run.py` printed UNRESEARCHED for the 40-F; every figure hand-built. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the AIF's Our Business, Competition, Impact of Regulations, Recent History and Risk Factors and from the MD&A, stated in the run file. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: the ten-year economics turn on batteries against hydrogen in heavy mobility, the survival of subsidies and mandates (DOE awards of about $40M terminated in 2025, the Texas Gigafactory abandoned), the price of hydrogen and its fuelling network, and which of thirteen named rivals survive ("further industry rationalization, failures" expected); the company declines revenue and net income guidance "in view of the early stage of hydrogen fuel cell market development" (6-K 0001279569-26-000211) and writes "We may never become profitable."; revenue $85.3M in 2016 and $99.4M in 2025, a net loss in every year of the ten; the start-up item of the OUT list weighed and not applied (founded 1979, about $100M of sales), the ground being fast-changing technology; GeoPura, with no filed earnings, turns on the same hydrogen variables. Q2 to Q12 not reached. After the stop, not weighed: ten-year balance sheets with share capital $977.7M to $2,433.2M and the accumulated deficit $(1,149.1)M to $(2,151.8)M, cash $1,123.9M (2021) to $502.1M (2026-06-30), no borrowing, goodwill written off and $111.0M of plant impaired in 2024; gross margin positive four quarters to Q2 2026 (20%), the 500-engine New Flyer order, Solaris and Wrightbus selections; Plug Power gross profit negative 2021 to 2025, Cummins Accelera segment EBITDA $(218)M to $(896)M and electrolyzer activity stopped; non-filing rivals flagged (Sinohytec, cellcentric, EKPO, Powercell, Bosch, Re-Fire, Sino-Synergy, Symbio, Hyundai; Honda and Toyota report no fuel cell segment); adjusted EBITDA featured, profitability dated "by the end of 2027" in one release and "by 2028" in another; GeoPura shares issued at $5.02 against $1.57; integrity facts recorded, not judged. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after all spending, stock pay and lease principal $(134.1)M a year equity-only, $(159.7)M all-equity, negative every year; net cash $402.9M after the GeoPura cash price and net debt; value range the no-growth case alone, **$(7.21) a share all-equity**, $(7.01) equity-only; fair price **$(3.39) all-equity, not positive**, $(3.81) equity-only. Contamination declared by the analyst: a filtered `Test Runs/` listing for this name to check the file name was free (no match, declared as a slip, the self-audit box left unticked), commit subjects of another company's re-run, the git status file list, a memory line; none used. Write-early departure declared: Step 0 and Q1 committed with the close in one commit after the template commit. Commits 941a2ff0 (template), 3018c93c (Step 0, Q1, box, after the stop, computation, self-audit, gaps). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` 27 ids, no problem; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cites.py` no missing id, 22 adjacent quoted fragments, **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) no test for when a long-lived, never-profitable company is a start-up (OUT) rather than fast-moving technology (TOO HARD); (2) Q7's convention gives no liquidation or cash floor for a business with negative owner cash every year; (3) IFRS 16 has no operating-lease category, so the all-equity basis's lease rule is unclear for an IFRS filer; (4) the commit rhythm for a file closed at Q1; also `tools/run.py` cannot read a 40-F. Not armed: box TOO HARD at Q1. Could not get: GeoPura's financial statements, the burn after 2026-06-30, fuel cell figures for Honda, Toyota and the non-filing rivals; not read: the Q1 2026 interim statements, the 2 MB exhibit of the 6-K of 2026-07-07, the FY2016 to FY2020 40-F texts.
runs.narr: TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q1 (Ballard Power Systems Inc., Nasdaq and TSX BLDP, 40-F filer, PEM fuel cells for bus, truck, rail, marine and stationary power, GeoPura bought 2026-08-28 largely in shares; the ten-year economics turn on batteries against hydrogen, subsidies, hydrogen prices and which of thirteen named rivals survive, and the company declines even one year's guidance; revenue $85.3M in 2016 and $99.4M in 2025, a loss every year; integrity facts recorded, not judged. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash $(159.7)M a year all-equity, negative every year; value range $(7.21) a share all-equity at $1.57; fair price $(3.39) all-equity, not positive, $(3.81) equity-only. Not held; not armed. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: start-up against fast-moving technology at Q1, no cash floor for a business burning cash every year, IFRS 16 leases on the all-equity basis, the commit rhythm for a file closed at Q1.)
